notes.title: v1.0.93 Translation Update
notes.notes:
• Added the following translations:
		○ Brazilian Portuguese (by Franklin J. Lima, Makk•, Esme413)
		○ French (by alynra)
		○ Turkish (by BlackRocky)
	• Fixed some translation errors in the following languages:
		○ English
		○ Russian (by Alan A)
	• Added a few amazing fanarts to the gallery! (permission granted from the artists)
	• Fixed some rare name-related Easter egg issues in multiple languages.
	• Adjusted the UI display for the backpack open/close animation.
	• Adjusted the delay for the sanity icon change detection.
	• Attempted to fix a bug where the player might get stuck at the Wheel of Fortune section.

A huge thank you to all the talented translators for their incredible work. As always, thank you for being part of this journey!

notes.title: v1.0.8 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where act select sometimes caused camera view problems.
Fixed a bug with mouse wheel speed issues when zooming in & out.
Fixed a camera view bug at the Flower Sea Terminal.
Removed a line of unclear dialogue.
Slightly adjusted the location of the healing item in the boss fight.
Slightly adjusted the positions of some images in the boss fight.
Fixed text overlap issues in certain languages.
(Again) attempted to fix the bug where the second letter puzzle could not be correctly solved.
(Again) attempted to fix the bug where the paper boat would become invisible during certain cutscenes.

notes.title: v1.0.71 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where pressing keys during cutscenes at the exit of the Block Maze would allow player move.
Fixed a bug where a specific spot during the boss fight unexpectedly caused damage.
Fixed a bug where a certain area in the Block Box allowed clipping.
Fixed a bug where music did not play in Ride's End.
Fixed a bug where NPCs occasionally triggered sound effects even when they had no dialogue.
Fixed a bug related to the Voucher Tycoon and Strongest Paper achievements when switching steam account.
Fixed a bug where the screen would occasionally glitch after conversations in the Wheel of Fortune corridor.
Fixed a bug where certain sound effects were bugged after finding Demetria in the Wheel of Fortune level.
Fixed several translation errors in Russian localization.
Added tutorial prompts for movement at the beginning.
Changed the order in which puzzle signs appear in Block Box.
Improved guidance for the Teddy's head in Block Box.
Optimized performance issues caused by an excessive number of moths in Park Train.
Attempted to fix a bug where the second letter puzzle could not be correctly solved.
Attempted to fix a bug where the player could become undead under certain circumstances.

notes.title: v1.0.51 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
• Fixed the bug where numeric keys could not be triggered to consume items
• Fixed the bug where Demetria’s dialogue could be mistakenly triggered after solving certain puzzles
• Fixed the bug where players could become undead at the exit of the block maze
• Fixed the bug where the game could not progress if Demetria got stuck at the exit of the block box
• Changed the terrain in the block box to prevent players from getting stuck
• Attempted to fix the bug where the game could freeze after the "TA-DA!!" line in Wheel of Fortune level
• Adjusted a part of Italian translation

notes.title: v1.0.4 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
• Fixed the bug where the Endless Hallway would repeat infinitely
• Fixed the bug where volume settings would sometimes revert
• Fixed the bug where the sign on the death screen would not be highlighted when clicked
• Fixed the bug that allowed items to be used in the extra content rooms
• Fixed the bug where some name Easter eggs would not trigger in certain languages
• Fixed the bug where Wuwu's gift box would be removed in the Wheel of Fortune level
• Fixed the bug where Demetria could get stuck in the wall at the exit of the block maze if the player was on the far right
• Attempted to fix the bug where cards might not appear on the screen during conversations with Aelios
• Attempted to fix the bug where the sanity face icon would disappear
